response.200: Serves the SPA home page (index.html). All data on this view is rendered client-side from the notes API; the home page itself exposes no mutating endpoint.

elements.name: Take a note...
elements.notes: Composer trigger; regex /take a note/i and /note/i used by openComposer. Also the note content textbox must satisfy getByLabel/getByPlaceholder /take a note/i, /note/i, /content/i.

elements.name: Search
elements.notes: Header search entry; must match getByRole searchbox|textbox name /search/i and getByPlaceholder /search/i.

elements.name: List view
elements.notes: View toggle; /list view/i or /grid view/i (toggleView/REQ-5.x). Default state must expose /list view/i text per REQ-5.2.

notes: REQ-1.1 (fixture public_homepage) only asserts page.goto('/') then expectHomePage: both visible texts /take a note/i and /search/i, plus the home page must render without JS errors. No API call is required for this node, so / is a static SPA route; data endpoints (GET /api/notes etc.) belong to dependent nodes. The two matchers are text-only (getByText), so 'Take a note...' and 'Search' must be visible text on load. For downstream REQ-2.x/3.x/5.x/6.x tests that also openHome and require openSidebar to be a no-op when /notes/i is visible, the sidebar should already be expanded by default and contain Notes text; the Main menu toggle reopens it after collapse (REQ-6.2). Public tests are authoritative; any conflict between this design and the fixtures must be reported rather than silently dropped.
